title: 1801 Prairie's carved pilasters and framed windows
items: The Kimball house's bowed bay and its south pavilion now carry the carved pilasters J. W. Taylor photographed: one to each storey, a chain of lozenges down its shaft, under a capital and on a corbel at the foot.
Every window of the bay and every pair in the pavilion now sits in a moulded stone frame under a projecting head, as in the print.
The carved frieze over the principal storey is still plain stone, and comes next.
